param: π Human recruitment/birth rate (annual birth rate as reported; used as inflow in human equations)
k Fraction of new human recruits vaccinated at entry
θ Waning of vaccine-induced protection (Vaccinated humans → Susceptible humans)
γ Loss of naturally acquired immunity (Recovered humans → Susceptible humans)
μ₁ Natural mortality rate of humans
μ₂ Natural mortality rate of mosquitoes
β₁ Transmission coefficient into vector-exposed humans from vaccinated humans (scaled by ε)
β₂ Transmission coefficient into vector-exposed humans from susceptible humans
ε Vaccine efficacy modifier reducing susceptibility (appears multiplying β₁ in infection of vaccinated humans)
α₁ Non-vector transmission coefficient into non-vector-exposed humans from vaccinated humans
α₂ Non-vector transmission coefficient into non-vector-exposed humans from susceptible humans
τ₁ Progression rate: vector-exposed humans → infectious humans
τ₂ Progression rate: non-vector-exposed humans → infectious humans
δ₁ Disease-induced mortality rate in infectious humans
σ Treatment initiation rate: infectious humans → treated humans
δ₂ Disease-induced mortality rate in treated humans
ω Recovery rate under treatment: treated humans → recovered humans
Λ Mosquito recruitment rate (inflow to susceptible mosquitoes)
β₃ Transmission coefficient into exposed mosquitoes from susceptible mosquitoes
φ Progression rate: exposed mosquitoes → infectious mosquitoes
